projects.title: Habit Streaker
projects.summary: A simple habit tracker tailored to my needs — digitising a notebook tracker without the complexity of existing apps.

details.heading: What I built
details.text: I wanted to digitise my habit tracker from a notebook to develop new healthy habits, but found existing solutions too complex and cumbersome. So I built one tailored to my needs that was simple and easy to use.

details.heading: What I learned
details.text: I was originally using Blink to build the app, but realised that Banani + Figma gives me more control over the designs to make finer attunements.

details.heading: What to improve next time
details.text: Because I deliberately kept this simple as a starter project, and the data is stored on the local device, changing my phone meant losing access to the original data and images stopped saving correctly. For later projects, I used Supabase integration to prevent such issues.
